title: Reconcile requirements after corrective pipeline proof
objective: Apply the updated final manifest so DS-056 records the demonstrated corrective pipeline and all 101 requirements have truthful terminal dispositions.

may: set the objective phase to COMPLETE
validate terminal counts and durable state
may_not: modify specification, policy, objective history, source, tests, docs, evidence artifacts, or sibling repositories
deploy, merge, push, or create a PR

relevant_context: DS-056 is now VERIFIED because a rejected packet failure led to a bounded corrective child and a distinct reconciliation retry
expected_deliverable: Exactly 98 VERIFIED, 2 DEFERRED_WITH_JUSTIFICATION, 1 NOT_APPLICABLE_WITH_JUSTIFICATION, and zero unaccounted requirements.
acceptance_criteria: DS-056 is VERIFIED with corrective evidence
DS-046 and DS-047 are explicitly deferred
DS-092 alone is not applicable with justification
deterministic_command: import{readJson}from'./src/io.js';import{setRequirements,updateState}from'./src/state.js';const root=process.cwd();const manifest=readJson('.opsle/final-reconciliation.json');const matrix=readJson('.opsle/requirements.json');const exceptions=new Set([...manifest.deferred,...manifest.not_applicable].map(x=>x.id));for(const item of matrix.requirements){if(!exceptions.has(item.id))setRequirements(root,[item.id],'VERIFIED',manifest.verified_evidence)}for(const item of manifest.deferred)setRequirements(root,[item.id],'DEFERRED_WITH_JUSTIFICATION',manifest.verified_evidence,item.justification);for(const item of manifest.not_applicable)setRequirements(root,[item.id],'NOT_APPLICABLE_WITH_JUSTIFICATION',manifest.verified_evidence,item.justification);updateState(root,{phase:'COMPLETE',pending_next_action:'Objective complete; remain inspectable and await operator direction.'})
